newsitem.title: USA: Farmland FY96 Aug 31 net declines.
newsitem.headline: Farmland FY96 Aug 31 net declines.

text.p: Farmland Industries Inc said consolidated income after taxes declined to $126.4 million for fiscal 1996, which ended August 31. In the year-earlier period, the large cooperative reported net income of $162.8 million.
Earnings declined largely because of the grain business, it said, citing supply problems for wheat resulting from drought conditions in some major producing areas.
Bolstered by higher selling prices for grain, soybeans, livestock feeds and pork, consolidated fiscal 1996 revenues rose to $9.8 billion from $7.3 billion in the previous fiscal year.

Farmland said the increase in total member business and higher profitability of fuel transactions with members, offset by lower profitability in certain segments, resulted in a decrease in total patronage refunds. Refunds were $93.5 million compared to $94.4 million in fiscal 1995.
